exercises.title: Slide check: the rules and the five core hooks
exercises.problemHtml:
Twelve questions on Slot 9–10: why hooks exist, the two rules of hooks, and when to use useState, useEffect, useContext, useReducer and useRef. These are the questions FE multiple-choice papers ask most often.

Tip: read every option before choosing — the wrong options are real mistakes students make in the FE exam.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All questions must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

Mẹo: đọc hết các lựa chọn rồi mới chọn — các phương án sai đều là lỗi thật sinh viên hay mắc trong đề FE.

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# Slide check: the rules and the five core hooks — answer key

1. Hooks were introduced in React…
   Answer: b) 16.8
   React 16.8 (February 2019). / React 16.8 (tháng 2/2019).

2. Which call breaks the rules of hooks?
   Answer: b) if (open) { useEffect(…) }
   Hooks must be called in the same order every render — never inside conditions or loops. / Hook phải được gọi cùng thứ tự mỗi lần render — không đặt trong điều kiện hay vòng lặp.

3. What does useState return?
   Answer: b) An array: [value, setter]
   Destructure it: const [count, setCount] = useState(0). / Tách ra: const [count, setCount] = useState(0).

4. useEffect(fn) with NO dependency array runs…
   Answer: b) after every render
   No array ⇒ after every commit. [] ⇒ once after mount. / Không có mảng ⇒ sau mỗi lần commit. [] ⇒ một lần sau mount.

5. The function returned from an effect is…
   Answer: b) the cleanup — run before the effect re-runs and on unmount
   Remove listeners, clear timers, cancel requests there. / Gỡ listener, xoá timer, huỷ request ở đó.

6. Why must the effect callback not be async?
   Answer: b) An async function returns a Promise, but React expects nothing or a cleanup function
   Define an async function inside and call it. / Khai báo hàm async bên trong rồi gọi.

7. useContext(MyContext) returns…
   Answer: b) the value of the nearest MyContext.Provider above, or the default
   The nearest provider wins. / Provider gần nhất thắng.

8. Signature of useReducer?
   Answer: a) const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(reducer, initialArg, init?)
   The optional third argument computes the initial state lazily. / Tham số thứ ba (tuỳ chọn) tính state ban đầu một cách lười.

9. When is useReducer preferred over useState? (choose all)
   Answer: a) Many related state fields + b) Next state depends on the previous one in several ways + d) You want to test the update logic as a pure function
   A single boolean is simpler with useState. / Một boolean đơn giản thì useState gọn hơn.

10. Changing ref.current…
   Answer: b) does not trigger a re-render
   Refs are for values that should not affect rendering (DOM nodes, timer ids). / Ref dùng cho giá trị không ảnh hưởng hiển thị (nút DOM, mã timer).

11. A custom hook is…
   Answer: b) a function whose name starts with "use" and may call other hooks
   Each component calling it gets its own state. / Mỗi component gọi nó có state riêng.

12. Two clicks call setCount(count + 1) twice in one handler (count = 0). Result?
   Answer: b) 1
   Both read the same snapshot. Use setCount(c => c + 1) to get 2. / Cả hai đọc cùng một ảnh chụp. Dùng setCount(c => c + 1) để được 2.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Xem giải thích từng câu sau khi nộp.

exercises.title: Order the life of an effect
exercises.problemHtml:
A component with useEffect(() => { subscribe(id); return () => unsubscribe(id); }, [id]) mounts with id 1, then id changes to 2, then the component is removed. Put the events in the order they happen.

Tip: read every option before choosing — the wrong options are real mistakes students make in the FE exam.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All questions must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Component có useEffect(() => { subscribe(id); return () => unsubscribe(id); }, [id]) mount với id 1, rồi id đổi thành 2, rồi component bị gỡ. Sắp các sự kiện theo đúng thứ tự xảy ra.

Mẹo: đọc hết các lựa chọn rồi mới chọn — các phương án sai đều là lỗi thật sinh viên hay mắc trong đề FE.

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# Order the life of an effect — answer key

1. Order the events
   Answer: m1) Render with id = 1 and commit to the DOM  →  m2) subscribe(1)  →  m3) Render with id = 2 and commit to the DOM  →  m4) unsubscribe(1)  →  m5) subscribe(2)  →  m6) Component removed: unsubscribe(2)
   Render/commit → cleanup of the old effect → new effect; on removal only the cleanup runs. / Render/commit → cleanup của effect cũ → effect mới; khi gỡ chỉ còn cleanup.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Mỗi lần phụ thuộc đổi: render → commit DOM → cleanup cũ → effect mới. Khi gỡ: chỉ còn cleanup.

muc.noiDung: Render with id = 2 and commit to the DOM
Render with id = 1 and commit to the DOM

cauHoi.giaiThich:
Render/commit → cleanup of the old effect → new effect; on removal only the cleanup runs.

🇻🇳 Render/commit → cleanup của effect cũ → effect mới; khi gỡ chỉ còn cleanup.

mistakesJson.loi: Đặt cleanup của id 1 sau subscribe(2).
